item.title: [AI & I by Every] How a Writer Uses AI Without Losing His Voice
item.description:
Speaker 1 | 00:00 - 00:14 I wake up and I don't touch the Internet. I won't look at my phone. I won't go online until long after lunch. As soon as I touch my phone, I feel the chemical shift and I can't go into any kind of deep thinking place or deep attention place or deep focus place.
Speaker 2 | 00:14 - 00:21 Because there's something about working with AI that feels very dopamine driven. And I believe strongly you can use it to do incredible work and also it's sort of a slot machine.
